tools.description: List the current dataset catalog with record counts. Browsing is free; existing query and daily-call limits apply.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Returns the row count of every dataset served here (depin_onchain, market_ticks and the rest), their total, the scope statement and the free-tier limits. No arguments, no key, read-only. For one network's live values use get_network; for freshness and history depth per feed use get_data_dictionary.

tools.name: get_data_dictionary
tools.description: ONBOARDING SPEC: freshness, history depth, coverage and endpoints per feed (depin_onchain, depin_daily, health_profiles, signal_ledger, market_ticks, zk_footprints). Machine-legible; answers 'how stale is this and how far back does it go' for every feed. Free, no key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: register_agent, list_products, purchase_data, get_stats, get_data_dictionary, get_depin_slashing_audit, get_listing_dilution_score · Private data: get_network_signals, register_agent, list_products, purchase_data, topup_credits, list_datasets, fetch_dataset, get_hodge_regime_sieve, get_rmt_regime_state, get_depin_slashing_audit, get_shap_node_attribution, get_listing_dilution_score · Public sink: register_agent, topup_credits, get_hodge_regime_sieve, get_rmt_regime_state, get_depin_slashing_audit, get_shap_node_attribution, get_listing_dilution_score.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: register_agent, list_products, purchase_data, get_stats, get_data_dictionary, get_depin_slashing_audit, get_listing_dilution_score · Private data: get_network_signals, register_agent, list_products, purchase_data, topup_credits, list_datasets, fetch_dataset, get_hodge_regime_sieve, get_rmt_regime_state, get_depin_slashing_audit, get_shap_node_attribution, get_listing_dilution_score · Public sink: register_agent, topup_credits, get_hodge_regime_sieve, get_rmt_regime_state, get_depin_slashing_audit, get_shap_node_attribution, get_listing_dilution_score

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
